title: meshy-single, rigged (char-mio-parts-1)
blurb: A real rigged 3D model, not a picture: the Meshy Mio from one picture (meshy-single, char-mio-gen3d-1), a copy decimated from 1,280,368 to 299,999 faces with its own texture, then Meshy auto-rig at 1.6 m. Idle and walk are the game's (Mio's approved idle and walk, carried over by bone name). Beside her: the in-game Mio, playing the same moves. Drag to turn, wheel to zoom.
